12.
The Commissioner-General shall write off, subject
to  sections  14  and  15,  any  tax  arrears  payable  under  the
provisions  of  any  law  specified  in  Schedule  I  other  than
Value Added Tax Act, No.14 of 2002, as at December 31,
2020,  by  any  individual  whose  assessable  income,
calculated in terms of the provisions of the Inland Revenue
Act, No. 24 of 2017, for the year of assessment ending on
March 31, 2020, does not exceed rupees three million:
